description.value: Mountainview Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and tasting lounge in Hope, BC, brewing its beers with local mountain water and offering a rotating draught list of ales, lagers, sours, and barrel-aged beers. The space is explicitly family-friendly with a kids menu, a dog-welcoming patio, and a mission to be an inclusive community gathering place. Touring cyclists will find it a natural stop on the Hope area routes, with confirmed bike parking steps from the front door and growler fills available.

address.value: 390 Old Hope Princeton Way, Hope, BC
